clauses.text: The Processor respects the conditions referred to in paragraphs 2 and 4 for engaging another processor.
clauses.title: Sub-processors

clauses.text: The Processor assists the controller by appropriate technical and organisational measures for the fulfilment of the controller's obligation to respond to requests for exercising the data subject's rights.
clauses.title: Assistance with Data Subject Rights

clauses.text: The Processor assists the controller in ensuring compliance with the obligations pursuant to Articles 32 to 36.
clauses.title: Assistance with Articles 32 to 36

clauses.text: The Processor at the choice of the controller, deletes or returns all the personal data to the controller after the end of the provision of services.
clauses.title: Deletion or Return of Personal Data

clauses.text: The Processor makes available to the controller all information necessary to demonstrate compliance with the obligations laid down in this Article and allow for and contribute to audits, including inspections.
clauses.title: Audit and Information Rights

clauses.text: The Processor's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not be limited in any respect.
clauses.title: Limitation of Liability

clauses.text: The Processor processes the personal data only on documented instructions from the controller, including with regard to transfers to a third country.
clauses.title: Processing on Documented Instructions

clauses.text: The Processor ensures that persons authorised to process the personal data have committed themselves to confidentiality or are under an appropriate statutory obligation of confidentiality.
